name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck: orders, kitchen
promotionalText: Receive orders in advance, protect the kitchen from too many orders and keep serving when the signal drops. The ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team runs service with.

Customers order in advance and choose a collection time. Your staff see all orders on a single screen, confirm what the kitchen can cook, then mark them as ready and collected.

NEVER PROMISE A TIME YOU CAN'T KEEP
Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. When a collection time is full, customers can no longer choose it, so the queue matches the kitchen.

TAKE ORDERS AT THE COUNTER
Add on-the-spot orders on the same screen as orders placed in advance, so the kitchen works from a single queue.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen screen shows what needs preparing now, what's next and what's ready, with an alert when an order needs starting.

PRINT ORDER TICKETS
Connect a kitchen ticket printer over Bluetooth or over the local network, and order tickets print automatically.

KEEP SERVING WHEN THE SIGNAL DROPS
Switch on offline protection and, if the connection is lost, advance orders pause so nobody places an order you can't see. Orders taken on the device are kept and sync when you are back online.

DESIGNED FOR THE FOOD TRUCK
Use the app on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during service, get a notification when an order needs confirming, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
Set up your events and locations once and take orders for each of them.

HatchGrab is for food truck operators and their staff. You need a HatchGrab account to sign in.
whatsNew:
